name: Seminary and Barry Aristocrats
description: The Seminary and Barry Aristocrats formed around 1965, founded by members who came out of the Black Saints, a street corner greaser gang that had existed on the North Side since the 1950s. The Aristocrats were not a rename of the Black Saints — they were a new group, though two former Black Saints members, Mickey and Jr. Lira (who became the Aristocrats' warlords), were prominent in starting it. The name was chosen democratically, partly because outsiders assumed 'Black Saints' referred to a Black club. The gang was mostly white but ethnically diverse, including Puerto Ricans, Mexicans, Irish, and Italian members, and was active in Chicago's Lakeview neighborhood.
